challenge.better_approach: Adding a CLI tooth to the 17b087f2483f proof was looked at: that proof is PROVED and sealed, and editing it reopens a closed voyage; a new proof under its own ticket is smaller. Testing only `cairn test --recheck-troubles` would leave bin/cmd/cleanup unpinned; running cleanup covers both in one tooth.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a scratch HOME needs no setup before cairn trouble drain: measured 2026-11-19, the drain lazy-starts a bus there; it fails only when the HOME path is too long for an AF_UNIX socket, which scratch_dir's /tmp path avoids.
challenge.prior_art: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_cleanup_rechecks_the_testers_seal_troubles.py (in-process teeth, which is the gap); cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_bus_a_test_run_spawns_is_the_runs.py (scratch HOME plus CAIRN_BUS_UNIT, stopped at the end).
challenge.real_collision: none: the 17b087f2483f proof and its seal are unchanged; this only adds a reader of the wiring.

answers.falsifier: Done when the tooth is green as built and red with either cleanup's seals step or cli.py's --recheck-troubles branch removed; wrong intent if the tooth needs live state (a sealed proof, the live store) to read green.
answers.from_idea: none, because it is the gap measured by ticket 17b087f2483f's hollow --seal: operator notices n-def5539f538c (cairn/devices/tester/cli.py) and n-9be844494f16 (bin/cmd/cleanup), each HOLLOW, no declared tooth redded
answers.how: New proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_cleanup_reaches_the_recheck_through_the_cli.py: under a scratch_dir HOME with its own CAIRN_BUS_UNIT, raise a seal-red for a gone proof through ModuleRaiser('tester'), drain it open, run bin/cairn cleanup, and assert the seals line clears it and trouble live no longer lists it. Proofs-only; no code changes.
answers.traces_to: Law 8: nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass; 17b087f2483f's wiring passed a proof that reverting it could not red.
answers.what: A behaviour tooth pins cairn cleanup's seals step and the tester's --recheck-troubles flag by running bin/cairn cleanup in a scratch HOME, so removing either reds it.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-19: the drafted tooth is green as built, red with `step seals` commented out, and red with cli.py's --recheck-troubles branch deleted; a scratch HOME under the session scratchpad breaks the drain (bus socket path too long).
